Overview:
This multi-functional incontinence pad is made from eco-friendly cotton and features a waterproof, washable design. It is suitable for elderly care, adult menstrual protection, and student dormitory use. The anti-leak design provides reliable protection, while various stylish patterns and size options meet the general needs of homes, offices, and other scenarios.
